regions.name: The Fallen Courtyard
regions.blurb: The gate you once rode out of. The banners have burned down to their poles.

stages.prompt: The outer wall has fallen in on itself. Something in garrison plate still walks its rounds.
Beyond the rubble the path divides.

options.label: The Guardhouse
options.hint: A door hangs from one hinge.

stages.prompt: A winch-house stands beside the inner gate. Its chain is rusted but whole.

options.label: Turn the Winch
options.hint: The gate would stay open behind you.

stages.prompt: A chapel alcove survives against the keep wall. A single candle burns.
The inner ward. He is standing exactly where he was posted.

regions.name: The Blackwood
regions.blurb: The royal hunting forest. The trees grew in over the road, and over the hunters.

stages.prompt: The road gives out under roots. Lanterns hang in the branches, still lit.
A deer trail leaves the road. The road goes on.

options.label: The Deer Trail
options.hint: White antlers move between the trunks.

stages.prompt: A ravine. A bridge of rope lies coiled on your side of it.

options.label: Cast the Bridge
options.hint: It will hold. It will also remain.

options.label: The Charcoal Burner's Hut
options.hint: The door is barred from outside.

stages.prompt: A gibbet tree, and beneath it a spring.

options.label: Drink
options.hint: The water is cold and clean.

options.label: Under the Gibbet
options.hint: The hanged have dropped their purses.

stages.prompt: A clearing of stumps. Every one has been used as a block.

options.label: The Clearing
options.hint: A cleaver drags somewhere in the dark.

regions.name: The Cathedral of Ash
regions.blurb: The faithful burned their own cathedral to keep it holy. It is still burning.

stages.prompt: Pilgrims' steps, worn into bowls. Ash falls like first snow.
At the great doors, a woman in red is waiting. She has been waiting a long time.
Inside, the nave is open to the sky. A side door leads to the sacristy.

options.label: Unbar the Sacristy
options.hint: A way in that avoids the steps.

options.label: The Reliquary
options.hint: Saints' bones, and what was buried with them.

stages.prompt: Votive candles, hundreds, none burned down.
The bell tower has fallen through the crossing. Something has made its den in the bronze.

regions.name: The Sunken Crypt
regions.blurb: The kings were buried under the cathedral. Then the river was let in.

stages.prompt: Stairs descend into black water. Lamps burn beneath its surface.
The ossuary. Skulls are stacked to the vault.

options.label: The Ossuary
options.hint: One niche is sealed with newer mortar.

stages.prompt: A sluice wheel. Turning it would drain the lower halls.

options.label: Open the Sluice
options.hint: The water would not come back.

options.label: The Dry Niche
options.hint: A saint's alcove above the waterline.

stages.prompt: With the water gone, a lower door stands revealed.
The oldest tomb. Its keeper has not left his post.

regions.name: The Frozen Citadel
regions.blurb: The mountain fortress. Its king had the gates frozen shut, and himself with them.

stages.prompt: The pass. Soldiers stand in ranks along it, upright, rimed white.
The curtain wall, sheathed in ice.
A counterweight lift, iced into its shaft.

options.label: Break the Ice
options.hint: It would run from the pass to the keep.

stages.prompt: The queen's solar. Frost flowers cover every pane.
The hall of the winter throne.

options.label: The Winter Throne
options.hint: He has not moved in an age. He moves now.

regions.name: The Hollow Throne
regions.blurb: The heart of the kingdom. You have been here before. You are always here before.

stages.prompt: The royal mile. Statues of every monarch, each with the face struck off.
The antechamber, hung with banners gone to thread.
A small door behind the arras, for the king's private use.

options.label: Unlock the King's Door
options.hint: Kings do not use the front.

stages.prompt: The throne room doors. They are open. They have always been open.

options.label: Behind the Throne
options.hint: Where a king hides what matters.

stages.prompt: The Hollow Throne.
